[Erowid Note: 
Some authors report suspicions that their cannabis has been 'laced' (adulterated), in some cases, presumably with PCP. While this is possible, readers should be aware that idiosyncratic response to the effects of cannabis (usually higher doses) can lead some users to presume their cannabis has been 'laced'. There is no way to know if the cannabis in the report below was adulterated or not. Reports of plant material and cannabis laced with powerful synthetic cannabinoids and other psychoactive substances became more common starting in 2007.]
Marijuana laced with acid, Alcohol, cigarettes
The first thing I noticed was that my peripheral vision seemed morphic. When I analyzed whatever I was in my vision it didn't seem unusual, but when it was in the background of my sight it shook and morphed slightly. When I looked in the mirror my body wasn't normal. I had three legs, but only when I wasn't staring at the two. My third leg came from the front of my body like an elephant trunk. My sight was reduced into cinematic cuts.
My sight was reduced into cinematic cuts.
Flick, flick, flick, flick-- it was like I wasn't seeing a consistent and coherent vision of the world. I was seeing it in pictures, and the space of time between my mental pictures of my surroundings was changed ever so much that the next thing I would see was a spontaneous snapshot. I didn't see A, B and C I saw straight from A to C and it appeared as though moments were disappearing from reality as I couldn't perceive a fluency of them. I looked like a monster-- Shiva. Multiple legs and arms.
I thought that by looking at pictures of myself I could calm down by seeing who I really was. My pictures were distorted looking to me and it offered no comfort. It did, however, give me a glance back into reality. Time didn't feel as though it had a forward momentum. I felt the NOW, not the past and not a prediction of the immediate future. This was fucking terrifying because it made me have an unreasonable craving to kill myself.
[Dose: "A lot"]
